summary: Recent updates in the Firefox browser's video decoding backend have focused on improving **protected playback** and enhancing video processing across various platforms, notably macOS and Android. Changes to the **Media Foundation API (MFCDM)** ensure better handling of DRM (Digital Rights Management) content, fostering a more reliable experience when streaming protected videos. Additionally, enhancements to the **AppleVTDecoder** make it safer to manipulate video data, while introducing support for **MediaCodec** and **AImageReader** on Android allows for more efficient video handling in GPU processes. These updates collectively enhance the performance and stability of video playback, ensuring smoother streaming experiences for users across different devices.
